home.description: An agent home checkout, separate from working directory; not a sandbox.

cwd.description: Optional default command directory, independent of the home checkout.

session_list.description: List every agent work-session record in the connected graph, as bundles: JSON objects with entity ids and their named groups of fields (components). Takes no arguments; includes sessions regardless of their status.
session_list.title: List sessions

session_new.title: Start a session here
session_new.description: Start an agent work session on this machine with an instruction, and run it until it settles: the model has answered and asks for nothing more. The session runs here, with this machine's shell, checkouts and sign-ins. Returns the session; `yak session new … --tui` then holds it in the terminal as the harness, to keep working in.

model.description: the model to ask, by name (default gpt-6-astra)

provider.description: the backend that serves it: openai or openrouter

session_send.title: Say more to a session here
session_send.description: Add an instruction to an agent work session and run it on this machine until it settles. Returns the session; under `--tui` the terminal holds it as the harness.

session.description: the session; pass its id or registered name

model.description: the model to ask, by name (default gpt-6-astra)

provider.description: the backend that serves it: openai or openrouter

model_list.title: List the models this machine can reach
model_list.description: Say which OpenAI credential this machine would send (OPENAI_API_KEY, else a Codex sign-in) and list the models its endpoint offers. The credential itself is never shown.
